findings.highlight: prolonging a battle due to my wound
findings.evidenceJa: 傷を理由に戦いを先延ばしにする
findings.governingReading: Saber rejects postponing the fight on account of her wound.
findings.explanation: The English changes delay before battle into extending the duration of a battle already underway.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry if I’m being unfair.
findings.governingReading: Shirou bitterly concedes, “Sorry for being unfair,” then maintains his refusal.
findings.explanation: The English adds an “if” and makes the retort sound like a tentative sincere apology, softening the wounded conflict.
